paper_title: Shining Light on the Dark Sector: Search for Axion-like Particles and Other New Physics in Photonic Final States with FASER
notes: FASER search for light long-lived particles decaying to two photons. Primary target is ALP coupled to W bosons (g_aWW), with reinterpretations including ALP-photon (g_agamma), ALP-gluon, U(1)_B gauge boson, up-philic scalar, and 2HDM. Multiple coupling types are constrained; the hint suggests AxionPhoton but the primary result is g_aWW (no enum value exists for W-boson coupling). No numerical exclusion limit data points (mass vs coupling pairs) are provided in the extractable text — limits are presented only in figures not reproduced as tables. Cannot reliably extract numerical limit values. | Vision: ALP-W coupling g_aWW (labeled ALP Coupling g_a [1/GeV]) interpreted as AxionPhoton type. The exclusion region is a closed loop; the lower boundary of the lower branch of the observed limit (90% CL, blue) is traced. Excluded region is between upper and lower branches. Points sampled densely near the rightmost turnaround (~300-360 MeV) where slope changes. | Calibration: No calibration needed
